races.paceDynamic: Suir Monad will take this field along from the front without serious pressure, creating a controlled tempo that suits his prominent style. Sir Aston and Nicky Larson may press forward early but neither looks likely to challenge for the lead outright. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Stellar View, Lunar Tide, Mount Eden, Gatlinburg, and Point Cartwright will sit off the pace expecting a sprint finish. This controlled gallop strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up brigade in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Suir Monad controls tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Suir Monad gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds an unassailable advantage while the hold-up horses get caught in traffic when trying to close. Front-runners and prominent racers dominate the finish with stamina telling over the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class tells in sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get clear runs and can unleash their finishing kicks
scenarios.body: Sir Aston's superior official rating and Stellar View's tactical speed prove decisive in a bunched finish. The front-runner weakens after setting steady fractions and gets swamped late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapse scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Suir Monad goes too fast early or gets pressured by multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable and the race falls apart in the final two furlongs. Patient hold-up horses with stamina reserves sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite contenders fail to fire and race shape suits a longshot
scenarios.body: Point Cartwright or Mighty Wave benefit from a perfectly run race to spring a surprise. The Bolger newcomer or McGuinness runner finds improvement on this easier assignment.

races.paceDynamic: The Blue Panther will take this race forward as the only confirmed front runner in a field of 17, but won't face early pressure with Rock Basher, Not Simple, She's Ideal and several other prominent runners likely content to track just behind. This creates a sustainable gallop that will allow the leaders to dictate terms through the middle stages on the testing soft ground at Gowran Park. The large field of hold-up horses including Galactic Grey, Lady Arwen, Roderick and Zephron will need luck in running and strong finishing kicks to overcome the tactical advantage. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those who can sit handy, as they'll avoid traffic problems and benefit from the controlled early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If The Blue Panther and prominent runners dictate a steady gallop without early pressure
scenarios.body: The leaders maintain their advantage as the soft ground saps the finishing kicks of hold-up horses who also encounter traffic problems in the large field. Those positioned prominently throughout get first run and prove too hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the middle stages allowing closers to get into contention
scenarios.body: The soft ground becomes less of a disadvantage when the gallop slows, and the class horses from the back get clear runs to unleash their finishing speed. Jockey strength becomes crucial in navigating the traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Compromise Winners
scenarios.trigger: If early pace is genuinely strong and the leaders tire but closers struggle for room
scenarios.body: Horses positioned in midfield get the best of both worlds - close enough to avoid traffic but far enough back to have something left when the leaders weaken. The versatile runners who can adapt their position prosper.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If The Blue Panther goes too slow and turns it into a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where positioning and luck matter more than class or form, creating opportunities for outsiders with the right trip. Traffic problems are severe but some hold-up horses find clear water.

watchPoints.text: The Blue Panther dictating terms on the front end - if allowed to control the pace unchallenged, will be very hard to peg back

races.paceDynamic: Magna Gee Gee stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will be allowed to dictate terms without early pressure from the start. The bulk of this field are hold-up horses (Khormor Syd, Ethelwulf, Deuteronomy, Starting Monday, Masego, Skib Gold, Broadchurch, Fantasy Fara) with only Sarangpur, I Do Believe and Prom Queen likely to race prominently behind the leader. This creates a tactical nightmare where the pace could collapse completely if Magna Gee Gee goes too slowly, leaving the hold-up brigade with too much to do on soft ground over this stamina-sapping trip. The race strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems and stamina-sapping finish kick that the hold-up horses will face.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Magna Gee Gee Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Magna Gee Gee sets sustainable fractions and maintains her kick
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on the field while the massed ranks of hold-up horses struggle to organize their challenge on the testing ground. Front running tactics prove decisive with prominent racers picking up the pieces.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the better-rated hold-up horses to conserve energy and unleash late runs. Horses with proven stamina and soft ground form come to the fore in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Sarangpur or I Do Believe can stalk without fading
scenarios.body: A prominent runner gets the perfect trip behind Magna Gee Gee and has enough left to pass the tiring leader. The hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the change of pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If nobody wants to race and it becomes a crawl
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where tactical positioning matters more than ability ratings. Any horse that gets a clear run and times their move right can capitalize.

races.paceDynamic: Holy See stands out as the sole confirmed front-runner in this 9-runner field, likely to dictate terms from the outset without early pressure. The prominent runners Star Harbour, Granite Bay, Denim And Diamonds and Rock Of Ireland will track behind in the early stages, while the hold-up quartet of Whimsy, Zoffman, Robbies Rock and Catch Fire settle towards the rear. With only one natural leader, Holy See can control the tempo and create a sustainable gallop that may not produce the strong finish typically needed for closers. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and handy horses who can track the leader and challenge approaching the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front-Running Success
scenarios.trigger: If Holy See gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The 5-year-old can utilise his 17lb weight advantage to kick clear in the straight, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the testing soft ground. His recent Dundalk form suggests he's ready to capitalise on ideal tactical conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely testing in the final 3f
scenarios.body: Star Harbour or Granite Bay can use their class advantage to reel in Holy See, with both horses showing recent form that suggests they're primed for a big effort. The soft ground plays to both horses' recent running style.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace completely collapses into a crawl
scenarios.body: Whimsy or Robbies Rock could unleash telling late runs, with both having shown ability to quicken when getting the right race setup. However, they need significant pace collapse to be effective over this distance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a tactical mess with no clear pace
scenarios.body: Rock Of Ireland's recent winning form could see him steal this at rewarding odds if the race falls apart tactically. His trainer's small but effective string suggests he arrives spot-on.

watchPoints.text: Holy See must be watched for market confidence given his 754-day absence - any significant support would be telling

Watch for Whimsy's trademark hold-up position - if positioned too far back early, his chances diminish significantly
Observe Granite Bay's jumping from the stalls as his prominent style requires good early positioning to be effective
Check if any of the returning absentees (Zoffman, Robbies Rock, Catch Fire) show signs of needed runs in preliminaries
